name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Account Management & Customer Success | Technology Clients
summary: Account manager and consultative seller with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and technology, growing revenue inside existing accounts through account planning, business reviews, and renewal proposals. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota doubled, advising C-suite clients on complex software solutions, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner reseller book at Birdeye (deals ~$10K-$45K). Has written proposals and statements of work in every sales role since 2018, and coordinates operations and technical teams to keep service levels on track.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients, documenting goals, timelines, and deliverables for each account in the CRM and Notion.
Grow existing accounts by identifying complementary services and writing proposals and SOWs with clear scope, cost, and expectations.
Report performance on a regular cadence with trend analysis and recommendations, using dashboards built in Power BI and GA4.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts, delivering quarterly business reviews that translated performance data into strategic recommendations.
Drafted proposals and statements of work and advised clients on budget planning and allocation.
Coordinated execution across internal departments and resolved client issues promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a named book of 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance trends to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Wrote proposals and SOWs, ran daily product demos, and coordinated with Product and Engineering on high-priority customer issues.
Managed the account book and pipeline in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total) and led the sales team.
Pursued a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect through to finalist stage.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery.
Contributed to a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps over 27 months, sustained while quota roughly doubled.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor and closing deals of $20K and larger.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.
Escalated account risk to leadership early and mitigated it with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
